name: Dense Sand
notes: Dry compacted tan/khaki sand (mean sRGB 147,128,99), fine grain with soft crusted clumps and shallow pits; very low contrast, so it tiles almost invisibly. Fully matte (roughness map ~0.98). One tile = 1.8 m x 1.8 m: repeat = groundSizeMeters / 1.8. Main open-ground surface; multiply material.color by ~1.1-1.15 for a lighter alluvial look. Budget split: diffuse 2k, normal/rough/AO 1k (an all-2k set would be 10.6 MB). Chosen over sand_01, whose dark twig repeats every 1.5 m.

name: Mud Cracked Dry Riverbed 002
notes: Sun-baked cracked alluvial mud, muted tan-brown (143,119,97). Polygonal plates ~10-25 cm across with shallow cracks; matte (~0.78). One tile = 2.0 m x 2.0 m. For road shoulders, paths, courtyards and dry canal banks; blend with ground_sand via a mask or vertex colour. Diffuse 2k; normal/rough/AO 1k (all-2k = 13.6 MB).

name: Clay Block Wall
notes: Hand-applied mud/clay render on a wall, ochre-brown (131,102,71). Shrinkage cracks follow ~20-25 cm courses, so it reads as mud-plastered mudbrick; bumpy relief with a few pale pebble inclusions; matte (~0.94). One tile = 2.0 m x 2.0 m (~8-9 courses): repeat = (wallWidth/2, wallHeight/2). For sun-bleached walls, lighten/warm via material.color (e.g. #ffe6c4 x ~1.2). Diffuse 2k; normal/rough/AO 1k (all-2k = 11.5 MB).

name: Wood Planks
notes: Weathered sawn planks, warm mid-brown (121,88,57). ~9 boards per tile (~17 cm wide) with visible grain, thin dark gaps and small peg/nail holes; matte (~0.86). Boards run horizontally: for vertical door planks set texture.center=(0.5,0.5) and rotation=Math.PI/2. One tile = 1.5 m x 1.5 m. Cedar gate doors: repeat ~ doorWidth/1.5 across the boards; roof beams: stretch along the beam axis. Diffuse + normal 2k; rough/AO 1k.

name: Hessian 380
notes: Tight plain-weave jute/hessian, warm tan (176,144,106), very uniform. Reads as rough linen/canvas at awning distance; roughness ~0.59 with slight fibre sheen. One tile = 0.274 m: repeat ~3.65 per metre (a 4 m awning -> ~14.6). Multiply material.color to dye cloth (it tints the tan base). Whole set at 1k (still ~3.7 texels/mm); 2k would be 12.7 MB with no visible gain.

name: Rough Concrete
notes: Despite the name, it reads as pale cleft limestone/sandstone: whitish cream-grey (184,181,156), fine granular pits, no aggregate, no formwork lines, no lichen; matte (~0.84). One tile = 1.23 m x 1.23 m. Use as micro-detail on the large Processional Way paving slabs (~1 tile per 1.05 m slab; randomise offset/rotation per slab). Slightly cool in crevices, so multiply by a warm tint (e.g. #f7e8cf). Whole set at 1k (~830 px/m because the tile is small). Replaced worn_rock_natural_01, rejected after viewing its 2k diffuse: ~10 bright yellow-green lichen patches repeating every 2 m.

name: White Sandstone Bricks 03
notes: Old buff/cream bricks (177,159,132) with a few ochre and one greyish unit, rounded worn arrises and recessed lime-mortar joints. ~13 courses per tile (~15 cm per course), units 25-55 cm long. Roughness ~0.53 is a little sheeny: set material.roughness ~1.4 (it multiplies the map; the shader clamps at 1) for dry fired brick. One tile = 2.0 m x 2.0 m; to match Babylonian baked brick (~33 x 8.5 cm, ~10 cm courses), scale to ~1.35 m per tile (repeat = size / 1.35). For unglazed walls and cores, not the blue glazed facade. Diffuse + normal 2k; rough/AO 1k.

name: Palm Tree Bark
notes: Sun-bleached grey-beige palm trunk (156,144,129) with horizontal leaf-scar rings ~13 cm apart, white flecks, one dark diagonal scuff streak (upper left) and two tiny rust-coloured specks; roughness ~0.70. The image is 1:2 (1024x2048). Poly Haven lists 1300x1300 mm, which matches the long (vertical) axis, so one tile ~0.65 m around x 1.3 m tall. Map U around the trunk with an INTEGER repeat (e.g. 2 on a ~35 cm diameter date palm) to avoid a seam; V = trunkHeight / 1.3; randomise U offset per tree. A brown multiply (e.g. #c9a27a) moves it toward date-palm bark. Whole set at 1k (an all-2k set = 23.7 MB).

name: Planter Pot Clay
notes: Unglazed, weathered red terracotta pot, conical with a rolled rim and flaking whitish wash; plausible as simple Neo-Babylonian earthenware. Real size ~0.27 m diameter x 0.22 m tall; 1 mesh, ~3.1k tris; no metal. A thin green moss/soil line on the INSIDE wall is visible only from above. Scale 1.5-3x for storage jars, or tint toward buff (#e3c7a0) to match typical calcareous Babylonian ware. Textures 1k: diff, nor_gl, arm (glTF ORM).

name: Wicker Basket 02
notes: Hand-woven natural-tan rattan basket with twine-bound rim, short wooden legs and a separate lid. Nodes: wicker_basket_02_base (~0.21 x 0.20 x 0.22 m) and wicker_basket_02_lid (placed beside the base in the file; move it on top or omit). No metal. Reed/palm-leaf baskets were everyday Mesopotamian items; this footed style is a generic stand-in for market stalls. ~17.9k tris total. Textures 1k.

name: Wooden Bowl 01
notes: Rough hand-carved wooden bowl with irregular rim and aged reddish-brown patina; ~0.31 m diameter x 0.09 m tall. ~14.1k tris: fine as a hero/market prop, heavy for mass instancing. Textures 1k.

name: Wild Rooibos Bush
notes: Low, dry, multi-stemmed desert shrub (Karoo species) with dark olive needle leaves; a believable stand-in for Mesopotamian steppe scrub along roadsides, wasteland and outskirts. 5 variants (nodes wild_rooibos_bush_a..e: 0.28-0.70 m wide, 0.31-0.54 m tall, 1.2k-13.2k tris). PATCHED: the Poly Haven glTF fed a JPG (no alpha) to alpha-card leaves, so they rendered as opaque quads. baseColor now points to the official RGBA PNG; leaves/twigs alphaMode BLEND -> MASK (alphaCutoff 0.5); unused JPG diffuse removed. Khronos glTF validator: 0 errors.

name: Grass Bermuda 01
notes: Bermuda grass (Cynodon dactylon, native to the region) as 21 small alpha-card tuft variants (dead_a/b, flattened_a, medium_a-f, seedling_a-d, single_a/b, small_a-f; 2-15 cm tall, 8-268 tris), laid out along X for InstancedMesh scattering. The Poly Haven thumbnail shows a Blender scatter, not one mesh. Mostly GREEN: use sparingly near the moat, canals and gardens. For dry ground prefer the *_dead_* tufts or multiply material.color by straw (#d8c18a). PATCHED like the shrub: baseColor -> RGBA PNG, alphaMode OPAQUE -> MASK (cutoff 0.5). Validator: 0 errors.
